summary: Allocates and returns a 24-byte (0x18) descriptor whose five dwords describe an inner buffer, and allocates that inner buffer. Calls MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(24) for the descriptor, defaults element size a2 to 8 when it is zero, stores element count a1 at dword index 2 (byte offset 0x8), zeroes dword index 0, stores a2 at dword indices 1 and 3 (byte offsets 0x4 and 0xC), stores a3 at dword index 4 (byte offset 0x10), then allocates the a2 * a1 byte inner buffer and stores it at dword index 5 (byte offset 0x14). Returns the descriptor pointer.

local_names.a1: element count of the inner buffer; stored at dword index 2
local_names.a2: element size; defaulted to 8 when zero, stored at dword indices 1 and 3
local_names.a3: additional scalar stored at dword index 4

operations.description: MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(24) allocates the 24-byte descriptor; its base is captured in v5/v6.
If element size a2 is zero, default it to 8 before it is used to size the inner buffer.
Store the element count a1 at descriptor dword index 2 (byte offset 0x8).
Zero the descriptor's first dword (byte offset 0x0).
Store the element size a2 at dword indices 1 and 3 (byte offsets 0x4 and 0xC).
Store a3 at dword index 4 (byte offset 0x10).
MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(a2 * a1) allocates the inner buffer (a2 bytes per a1 element) and stores it at dword index 5 (byte offset 0x14).
Return the fully initialized descriptor pointer v6.
Invoked by MemoryObjectAllocator (00562B50), DirectDrawDisplayModeInit (00563E00) and AllocateIntArrayViaFactory (005646D0) to build this descriptor.
